C0697.title: Wuhan Police Dismantle Dropshipping Store Cluster Scam Gang
C0697.summary: The East Lake High-tech Development Zone Branch of the Wuhan Public Security Bureau dismantled a fraud gang disguised as an e-commerce company, arresting 98 suspects and involving over 10 million yuan.
